newsitem.title: TAIWAN: New Taiwan Semicon plant plans February production.
newsitem.headline: New Taiwan Semicon plant plans February production.

text.p: Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Corp, Taiwan's top chipmaker, said on Wednesday its fourth wafer fabrication plant would start production in February.
The new plant, which will make chips based on eight-inch wafers, was expected to attain T$4 billion in revenues for the company in 1997, Taiwan Semiconductor said in a statement.
Taiwan Semiconductor started building the factory in 1995.
The high-tech plant should reach output of 22,000 eight-inch wafers a month by the end of 1997 and hit full capacity of 30,000 wafers a month by the end of 1998, it said.
